_schema.id: S01, S02... Split as S03a/S03b; never renumber (prompts, VO files and ledger entries key off ids).
_schema.kind: title | statement | stat | list | quote | lowerThird | footage | image | endCard
_schema.vo_text: Exactly what the voice says (real spelling; the brand lexicon handles pronunciation). Empty = no VO.
_schema.kicker/headline/body/stat/items/name/rol: On-screen copy. Keep headlines short: ~20 on-screen words per section at most.
_schema.media: Project-relative path to a footage clip or still for footage/image/lowerThird scenes.
_schema.duration: Fixed length (overrides VO-driven length). Use for music-cut films.
_schema.target_vo_seconds: VoiceStudio only: ask the TTS to fit the line into N seconds (--fit-duration).
_schema.maker: remotion | hyperframes | ai-video | footage | stock (who makes the picture)
_schema.job: The one thing this scene must do (orientation, comprehension, belief, recall, feeling or action).
